import os,subprocess,json,hashlib,base64,sys,time,re

w=Path.cwd();run=Path(os.environ.get("LEAN")or os.environ["LAKE_OVERRIDE_LEAN"]).parents[2]
owner=w/"Aglib/AlgebraicGeometry/EtaleCohomology/Kummer/SectionPullback.lean"
assert hashlib.sha256(owner.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="b73fc2502fcec17922245aa5445c81552166355cf94be78da6bc28fece7d0340"
blob=base64.b64decode('');assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()=='8bdbfaaf920e4f6fa7d6f5d1b712be103ba6e6cf1e05db7d011eb5618c35e7cf'

source=run/"RootsSectionProofCuts.lean";source.write_bytes(blob)
